Bug 519754 - improving performance of long running save action

Moved operations in smaller scope, so that they run only when necessary.
This improves performance in some situations, when adjusting indentation
during save action.

E.g. for 16k commented lines, indentation takes 1/3 of the original time
(40 seconds, down from 120 seconds).

Bug 520648: [9] module-info should be displayed with correct icons

Change-Id: Ie8e12f00a47a989ee924ed21170691dfa54d3280
dslRule:
<!id: add-module-info-check>
<!description: Add module-info check to instanceof conditions for ICompilationUnit and IClassFile elements when handling Java 9+ modules.>
<!severity: WARNING>
<!map ELEMENT_TYPE: "org.eclipse.jdt.core.ICompilationUnit" => "org.eclipse.jdt.core.ICompilationUnit", "org.eclipse.jdt.core.IClassFile" => "org.eclipse.jdt.core.IClassFile">

$element instanceof #{ELEMENT_TYPE} :: sourceVersionGE(9)
=> $element instanceof #{ELEMENT_TYPE} && !org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.JavaModelUtil.isModuleInfo((#{ELEMENT_TYPE_VALUE}) $element)
;;
summary: Adds a check `!JavaModelUtil.isModuleInfo(element)` to existing `instanceof ICompilationUnit` or `instanceof IClassFile` expressions, targeting Java 9+ projects.

<!description: Extract the call to MessageDialog.open() into a local variable before a switch statement to improve readability and allow reuse of the dialog result.>
<!severity: HINT>

    $statements$
} :: instanceof($dialog, "org.eclipse.jface.dialogs.MessageDialog")
=>
int $answer = $dialog.open();
switch ($answer) {
    $statements$
}
;;
